# `em select news read`

- **Usage:** `em select news read [IDS]…`

Read news items (numbers/names from `list`; "new"/"all", or none for all unread)

## Arguments
- **`[IDS]…`** — Item numbers/names from `list`, the single keyword "new" (every unread item) or "all" (every item), or omit for "new".

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Output Formats

- **`json`** — Machine-parsable JSON (`--json` with `-p` or `--info`)

  **Framing:** `json`
